answer_1.quote: We are particularly interested in how LLMs such as ChatGPT perform for modeling document-level text, encompassing discourse phenomena such as entity consistency, referential expressions, and coherence. Taking document-level MT as a testbed, we conduct an empirical study...

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a human evaluation... We establish two sets of evaluation criteria: 1) general quality, covering aspects such as fluency and adequacy; 2) discourse-aware quality, including factors such as consistency, word choice, and anaphora.
